description: Original 0.15.0 synthesis revisions after the all-pair, multi-register dry/wet audit. Exact factory names and IDs remain stable. Explicit project/user-preset parameters take precedence over these factory recipes. No audio is stored.

Chorus Guitar - Afterglow.designNotes: Bright, short picked-string voicing with a downward body sweep, distinct from the sustained soul and indie strings.

Acoustic-Style Guitar - Afterglow.designNotes: A blooming string onset and resonant body opening distinguish the alternate acoustic voicing from muted game-guitar and nylon strings.

Lo-Fi Guitar.designNotes: Damped thumb-pluck excitation and a compact decay define the dry sound before tape effects.

Latin Guitar.designNotes: Brighter finger-pluck excitation, a longer string resonance and a closing filter distinguish it from neo-soul guitar.

Reed Electric Piano - Afterglow.designNotes: Alternate reed-like FM excitation uses a subharmonic modulator and longer electric-key decay instead of the grand-style modal spectrum.

Jazz Keys.designNotes: A soft electric-key onset and mellow three-to-two FM operator structure separate these keys from the grand and upright modal designs.

Jazz Keys - Afterglow.designNotes: A mallet-like, short modal attack with a darker high-pass body gives the alternate jazz patch a distinct dry envelope and spectrum.

Slap-Style Bass.designNotes: A sharp, resonant low-pass snap emphasizes bass articulation rather than the open upper-register game-guitar spectrum.

Slap-Style Bass - Afterglow.designNotes: A punchy FM alternate with a one-to-one operator ratio supplies a different bass body from all guitar/string patches.

Harp-Style Pluck.designNotes: A bright long-resonating string with a high-pass body creates a lighter glassy harp tone, distinct from open guitar and slap-bass strings.

Tape Menu Harp.designNotes: A rounded, blooming menu-string envelope and lower body resonance establish the tape harp before wow and bit reduction.

Tape Menu Harp - Afterglow.designNotes: A short band-pass, high-excitation string creates a hollow game-menu pluck instead of another muted acoustic guitar.

Detroit Concrete Upright - Afterglow.designNotes: A rounded resonant upright-key body with a softer attack and sustained modal tail, distinct from the short offbeat hammer and celesta designs.

Detroit Late Shift Piano.designNotes: A darker rounded modal strike and longer body decay distinguish this late-night key patch from music-box bells.

West Coast Neon Music Box.designNotes: Inharmonic FM glass with a 5.19 operator ratio replaces the toy-piano-like modal tone while retaining a music-box envelope.

West Coast Chrome String Pluck - Aftergl.designNotes: A nasal resonant string with a rising body filter and compact release contrasts with the muted harp alternate.

West Coast Portside Sine Lead.designNotes: A soft sine body with a quiet octave triangle and slower attack separates this rounded lead from the pure high whistle alternate.

Florida Bright Club Piano.designNotes: Bright, mostly harmonic modal keys with an assertive short filter transient separate club piano chords from the inharmonic retro marimba.
